name: Community Bancorp
summary: Community Bancorp. operates as the bank holding company for Community National Bank that provides various financial services to individuals, businesses, nonprofit organizations, and municipalities in northern and central Vermont. The company offers financing for commercial business properties, equipment, inventories, and accounts receivable, as well as standby letters of credit; and business checking and other deposit accounts, cash management services, repurchase agreements, ACH and wire transfer services, card processing, and remote deposit capture.
